storyCards.fact:
Green Day's "Boulevard Of Broken Dreams" reached #2 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #2 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 36 weeks on the chart.

Boulevard Of Broken Dreams was released in 2004.
